CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An emotional appeal tries to influence an audience through feelings.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an appeal to authority?
options: Using an authority's statement as support for a claim
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An appeal to authority cites an expert or recognized authority as support; its strength depends on relevance and credibility.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an abstract in academic writing?
options: A brief overview of a longer work
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An abstract summarizes a study or longer work.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a paraphrase?
options: Restating an idea in one's own words while preserving meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A paraphrase restates an idea in new wording and still requires attribution when based on a source.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a quotation?
options: Words reproduced from a source and marked as such
A personal guess with no source
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A quotation reproduces source wording and should be clearly marked and attributed.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an annotated bibliography?
options: A source list with brief notes about each source
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An annotated bibliography includes source details and explanatory notes.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a research question?
options: A focused question that guides an investigation
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A research question defines what an investigation aims to find out.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a hypothesis?
options: A final proven fact in every case
A testable proposed explanation or prediction
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A hypothesis is a proposed explanation or prediction that can be tested.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a survey used for?
options: Identifying every metaphor in a poem
Collecting responses from a group of people
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Surveys gather information from respondents using structured questions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a questionnaire?
options: A set of questions designed to collect information
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A questionnaire is a prepared set of questions for collecting data.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a press release?
options: An organized announcement intended for media distribution
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A press release communicates news or an announcement to media outlets.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a feature article?
options: An article that explores a subject in depth with a narrative or human-interest approach
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Feature articles often explore a subject in depth beyond a brief news report.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a public service announcement?
options: A message intended to inform or benefit the public
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A public service announcement communicates information intended to serve the public interest.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an advertisement's call to action?
options: A prompt encouraging the audience to take a next step
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A call to action invites the audience to do something specific.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a stereotype?
options: A verified description of every individual
An oversimplified generalized belief about a group
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Stereotypes oversimplify groups and may misrepresent individuals.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is cultural context?
options: The social and cultural circumstances surrounding a text or event
The number of pages in a book
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Cultural context can shape a text's meaning and interpretation.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is oral tradition?
options: Passing stories, songs, and knowledge by speaking and listening
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Oral tradition transmits cultural knowledge through spoken forms across generations.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is folklore?
options: Traditional beliefs, stories, customs, and expressive practices of a community
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Folklore includes a community's traditional stories, beliefs, and practices.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a literary canon?
options: A body of works regarded as important within a tradition
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A literary canon is a body of works considered significant within a tradition.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is literary criticism?
options: Analysis and interpretation of literary works
Copying a story without reading it
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Literary criticism examines how literary works function and what they mean.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is comparative literature?
options: Study of literature across languages, cultures, or traditions
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Comparative literature explores relationships among works and traditions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a translation's source text?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: The source text is the original text from which a translation is made.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a target language?
options: The language into which a text is translated
The language used only by the source author
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: The target language is the language receiving the translation.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a false friend in language learning?
options: A similar-looking or sounding word with a different meaning
A word with exactly the same meaning in every language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: False friends can mislead learners because similar forms may have different meanings.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is language preservation?
options: Changing every word into a loanword
Efforts to maintain and transmit a language across generations
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Language preservation supports continued use, learning, and transmission of a language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is language revitalization?
options: Efforts to increase use and learning of a language that has weakened
The removal of a language from public life
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Revitalization supports renewed use and intergenerational transmission.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Why are regional languages important?
options: They carry community knowledge, identity, and cultural expression
They must all use one script
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Regional languages can carry cultural knowledge, identity, and literary traditions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is multilingualism?
options: The use or knowledge of more than one language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Multilingualism involves using or knowing multiple languages.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is language shift?
options: A community's gradual movement from one language to another
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Language shift occurs when a community increasingly uses another language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a language standard?
options: A socially recognized form used for specified contexts
The only possible way anyone can speak
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Standard varieties are used in particular formal, educational, or public contexts.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is descriptive grammar?
options: An account of how people actually use a language
A list of rules that people must never vary
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Descriptive grammar describes language patterns as used by speakers and writers.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is prescriptive grammar?
options: Rules or recommendations about how language should be used in specified contexts
A record of every speaker's pronunciation only
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Prescriptive grammar recommends particular forms for certain contexts.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a language's writing system?
options: The conventions used to represent language in writing
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A writing system represents language using established graphic conventions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is orthography?
options: The conventional spelling and writing rules of a language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Orthography covers conventional spelling and writing conventions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a grapheme?
options: A basic functional unit of a writing system
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A grapheme is a basic unit used to represent distinctions in writing.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a phoneme?
options: A sound unit that can distinguish meaning in a language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A phoneme is a contrastive sound unit in a language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a syllable?
options: A unit of pronunciation organized around a vowel or syllabic nucleus
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A syllable is a unit of spoken language organized around a nucleus, commonly a vowel.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is intonation?
options: The pattern of pitch movement in speech
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Intonation concerns pitch patterns across spoken phrases or sentences.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a pause in speech useful for?
options: Separating ideas and supporting clarity or emphasis
Changing a noun into a verb
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Pauses can help structure spoken information and signal emphasis.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is non-verbal communication?
options: Communication through gesture, facial expression, posture, and similar cues
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Non-verbal communication conveys information without words alone.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an appropriate response in conversation?
options: A reply unrelated to the topic every time
A response relevant to what the other person said
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Relevant responses help sustain clear and cooperative conversation.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is empathy in communication?
options: Trying to understand another person's feelings or perspective
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Empathy supports understanding of another person's perspective.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is register choice influenced by?
options: Only the title of a book
Only the number of letters in a word
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Language register varies with audience, purpose, setting, and relationship.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is editing?
options: Revising content and structure to improve clarity and effectiveness
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Editing improves organization, clarity, style, and content.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is proofreading different from editing in general?
options: They always mean exactly the same thing
Proofreading focuses more on surface errors; editing may address content and structure
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Proofreading usually targets spelling, grammar, and punctuation, while editing may also revise structure and meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a topic sentence?
options: A sentence stating the main idea of a paragraph
The final page of a book
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A topic sentence often signals the paragraph's main idea.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is supporting detail?
options: Information that explains or backs up a main point
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Supporting details develop or substantiate a main point.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a transition between paragraphs meant to do?
options: Help readers follow the relationship between ideas
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Transitions guide readers from one idea or paragraph to another.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an expository text?
options: A text consisting only of stage directions
A text that explains or informs about a subject
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Expository writing explains a topic or presents information.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a descriptive text?
options: A text that contains only equations
A text that presents details to help readers imagine a person, place, object, or experience
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Descriptive writing uses details to represent a subject vividly.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a narrative text?
options: A text that tells a sequence of events
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Narrative texts present events in a sequence.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an argumentative text?
options: A text that advances and supports a claim
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Argumentative writing develops a claim with reasons and evidence.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a reflective piece of writing?
options: A list of spelling rules only
Writing that examines experiences and insights
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Reflective writing considers experiences and what can be learned from them.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a diary entry?
options: A dated personal record of experiences or thoughts
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Diary entries commonly record personal events, feelings, or reflections.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a travelogue?
options: An account of journeys and experiences while travelling
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A travelogue describes journeys, places, and experiences.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a travel writer likely to include?
options: Observations of places, people, and experiences
Only a list of punctuation marks
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Travel writing often combines observation, description, and personal experience.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a character sketch?
options: A drawing of the book cover only
A brief description of a character's traits and behaviour
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A character sketch highlights a character's important traits and behaviour.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a book's preface often used for?
options: To provide introductory remarks about the work
To give the story's full ending only
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A preface commonly introduces the work and may explain its background or purpose.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a foreword?
options: An introductory text, often written by someone other than the author
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A foreword is an introductory text often written by another person.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an epilogue?
options: A concluding section after the main narrative
A book's index at the beginning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An epilogue appears after the main narrative and provides closure or later context.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a prologue?
options: An introductory section before the main narrative
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A prologue precedes the main narrative and can provide context.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an anthology?
options: A collection of selected literary works or excerpts
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An anthology collects selected works, often by multiple authors.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a literary adaptation?
options: A reworking of a work into another form or medium
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An adaptation reinterprets a work for a different form, audience, or medium.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a stage adaptation?
options: A version of a story prepared for theatrical performance
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A stage adaptation reshapes material for theatre.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a screenplay?
options: A script for a film or screen production
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A screenplay includes dialogue and directions for screen storytelling.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a scene in drama?
options: A section of a play's action, often within a particular setting
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Scenes organize dramatic action into sections.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a chorus in some dramatic traditions?
options: A group that speaks or sings collectively and may comment on events
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A chorus may comment on or frame dramatic action through collective speech or song.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is comic relief?
options: A humorous moment that eases tension in a serious work
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Comic relief introduces humour to reduce tension.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is tragedy as a dramatic form?
options: A serious drama often involving suffering or downfall
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Tragedy explores serious conflict and often suffering or downfall.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is comedy as a dramatic form generally designed to do?
options: Use humour and often resolve conflict positively
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Comedy commonly uses humour and often moves toward a positive resolution.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a stage prop?
options: An object used by performers during a production
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Props are objects used in theatrical performance.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a director's role in theatre?
options: To shape and coordinate the performance
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A director guides the staging, interpretation, and coordination of a production.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a character's dialogue tag used for in prose?
options: To identify who is speaking or how they speak
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Dialogue tags attribute speech to a character and may describe delivery.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an author's style?
options: The characteristic choices in language, structure, and expression
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Style includes characteristic diction, syntax, imagery, and structural choices.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is diction?
options: An author's or speaker's choice of words
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Diction refers to word choice.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is syntax in literary style?
options: The arrangement of words and phrases into sentences
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Syntax concerns sentence structure and word arrangement.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a motif different from a theme in general?
options: A motif recurs as an element; a theme is a broader idea
There is no distinction in any context
A motif is always the title
A theme is a punctuation mark
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Motifs are recurring elements that can help develop a broader theme.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an allusion?
options: A reference to a person, event, work, or idea known from another context
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An allusion refers indirectly to something outside the immediate text.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is anaphora?
options: Repetition of a word or phrase at the beginnings of successive clauses or lines
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Anaphora repeats words at the beginnings of successive units.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is juxtaposition?
options: Placing elements side by side to highlight contrast or relation
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Juxtaposition places elements near each other to invite comparison.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is ambiguity in a literary text?
options: The possibility of more than one interpretation
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Ambiguity allows multiple plausible meanings or interpretations.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a paradox?
options: A word with a similar meaning
A statement that seems contradictory but may express an insight
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A paradox appears contradictory but can reveal a meaningful truth.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an archetype?
options: A recurring character type, image, or pattern
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Archetypes are recurring patterns across stories and cultures.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a bildungsroman?
options: A novel focused on a protagonist's development or coming of age
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A bildungsroman traces a character's growth toward maturity.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is stream of consciousness in literature?
options: A technique representing the flow of a character's thoughts
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Stream of consciousness attempts to represent the flow of thought and perception.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a frame narrator?
options: A narrator who presents or introduces an embedded story
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A frame narrator helps establish the narrative that contains another story.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an open ending?
options: An ending that explains every detail
An ending that leaves important questions unresolved
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Open endings invite readers to consider unresolved possibilities.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a closed ending?
options: An ending that resolves the major narrative questions
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A closed ending provides resolution to the main narrative conflicts.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a cliffhanger?
options: A full summary of the ending
A suspenseful ending that leaves a key event unresolved
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A cliffhanger leaves readers waiting for the outcome of an important event.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is pacing in a story?
options: The rate at which narrative events and information unfold
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Pacing controls how quickly or slowly a narrative develops.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is point of view?
options: The perspective from which a story is narrated
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Point of view determines whose perspective shapes the narrative.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an omniscient narrator?
options: A narrator who knows only one word
A narrator with broad access to characters' thoughts and events
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An omniscient narrator can present information beyond one character's knowledge.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is limited third-person narration?
options: Third-person narration closely following one character's perspective
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Limited third-person narration restricts access largely to one character's experience.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a flash-forward?
options: A narrative passage that jumps ahead to a later event
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A flash-forward presents an event from later in the story's timeline.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an epiphany in a story?
options: A sudden realization or insight experienced by a character
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An epiphany is a moment of sudden understanding.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a tragic flaw traditionally?
options: A character trait contributing to a tragic downfall
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A tragic flaw is a trait that contributes to a protagonist's downfall in some tragic traditions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is catharsis in discussions of tragedy?
options: A release or purgation of strong emotions
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Catharsis is commonly discussed as an emotional effect of tragedy.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is dramatic irony?
options: When the audience knows something a character does not
When every character knows the same facts
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Dramatic irony occurs when the audience's knowledge differs from a character's.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a subplot?
options: A secondary story line within a larger narrative
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A subplot develops alongside the main plot.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a narrative frame?
options: The structure that surrounds or contextualizes a story
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A narrative frame establishes the context in which a story is told.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a literary movement?
options: A group of works or writers sharing historical or stylistic tendencies
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Literary movements are associated with shared historical, stylistic, or intellectual features.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is modernism in literature broadly associated with?
options: Experimentation with form and responses to modern life
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Modernist writing often experiments with form and responds to rapid social change.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is realism in literature broadly concerned with?
options: Representing recognizable social life and ordinary experience
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Realism often emphasizes plausible characters and recognizable social circumstances.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is romanticism in literature broadly associated with?
options: Emphasis on imagination, emotion, and nature in many works
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Romanticism often values imagination, emotion, nature, and individual experience.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is naturalism in literature broadly associated with?
options: Attention to environment, heredity, and social forces shaping lives
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Naturalist works often examine how environment and social conditions shape human lives.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is postcolonial literature often concerned with?
options: Colonial power, identity, language, and its aftermath
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Postcolonial literature frequently examines colonial histories and their cultural consequences.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is feminist literary criticism?
options: Analysis of gender, power, representation, and literary traditions
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Feminist criticism examines gender and power in texts and literary institutions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is ecocriticism?
options: Study of literature's relationship with the environment
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Ecocriticism explores how texts represent nature, place, and environmental concerns.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is reader-response criticism?
options: An approach examining readers' roles in producing meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Reader-response approaches examine how readers participate in interpretation.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is structuralism in literary studies broadly concerned with?
options: Systems and patterns that shape meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Structuralist approaches study systems and relations underlying texts and meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is deconstruction in literary criticism broadly concerned with?
options: Tensions and instabilities within texts and concepts
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Deconstructive readings examine tensions in how texts produce meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is intertextuality?
options: The relationship of one text to other texts
A type of sentence without a verb
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Intertextuality concerns connections among texts through reference, influence, or shared forms.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a literary allusion likely to rely on?
options: A reader recognizing an external reference
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Allusions often gain meaning when readers recognize the referenced work or idea.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a cultural idiom?
options: A word that has no meaning
An expression whose meaning is shaped by a community's language and practices
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Idioms often reflect cultural usage and cannot always be translated word for word.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a language's literary tradition?
options: Works, genres, practices, and influences developed over time
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A literary tradition includes works and practices passed on or transformed over time.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a literary award intended to recognize?
options: The number of words in a dictionary
Achievement in writing or literature according to its criteria
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Literary awards recognize work according to the award's specific rules and standards.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a translator's note sometimes used for?
options: To replace the source text entirely
To explain a translation choice or cultural reference
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A translator's note can clarify decisions, context, or references that may not transfer directly.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a literal meaning?
options: The direct or conventional meaning of an expression
Always the opposite of its words
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Literal meaning is the direct meaning before figurative interpretation.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is figurative language?
options: Language used imaginatively beyond its strictly literal sense
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Figurative language uses expressions such as metaphor, simile, and personification.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a semantic field?
options: A group of words related by meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A semantic field groups words connected by a shared area of meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a collocation?
options: A combination of words that commonly occur together
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Collocations are word combinations that commonly co-occur in a language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is register-sensitive vocabulary?
options: Word choice suited to a particular context or level of formality
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Vocabulary choices vary with formality, audience, and setting.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a language learner's receptive skill?
options: Understanding language through listening or reading
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Listening and reading are receptive skills.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a productive language skill?
options: Speaking or writing to create language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Speaking and writing are productive skills.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a communicative language task designed to practice?
options: Using language to achieve a real communicative purpose
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Communicative tasks focus on conveying and understanding meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is formative assessment?
options: Assessment used during learning to guide improvement
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Formative assessment provides feedback that can guide teaching and learning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is summative assessment?
options: Assessment that evaluates learning at the end of a period or unit
Feedback given only before learning starts
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Summative assessment evaluates achievement after a period of instruction.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What makes a multiple-choice question well designed?
options: One clearly best answer and plausible distractors
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A well-designed item has a clear stem and defensible answer options.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is a distractor in a multiple-choice item?
options: The correct answer in every case
An incorrect option designed to be plausible
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Distractors are incorrect options intended to distinguish knowledge levels.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an answer key?
options: A record identifying the correct answers
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An answer key identifies the correct response for each item.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: What is an explanation in a question bank useful for?
options: Showing why the correct option is correct
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Explanations help learners understand the reasoning behind an answer.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which script is primarily used to write Malayalam?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Malayalam is written primarily in the Malayalam script.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Malayalam belongs to which language family?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Malayalam is a Dravidian language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which state in India is most closely associated with Malayalam as its principal language?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Malayalam is the principal language of Kerala.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which of these is a Malayalam vowel letter?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: അ is a Malayalam vowel letter.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which of these is a Malayalam consonant letter?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: മ is a Malayalam consonant letter.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the usual function of a full stop in Malayalam writing?
options: Mark the end of a sentence
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A full stop commonly marks the end of a sentence.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which punctuation mark usually indicates a question?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A question mark is used after a direct question.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which part of speech names a person, place, thing, or idea?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A noun names a person, place, thing, or idea.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which part of speech expresses an action or state?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A verb expresses an action or state.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which part of speech can replace a noun?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A pronoun can stand in place of a noun.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which part of speech describes a noun?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An adjective describes or qualifies a noun.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Which part of speech modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An adverb modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a synonym?
options: A word with the opposite meaning
A word with a similar meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Synonyms have similar meanings.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an antonym?
options: A word with a similar meaning
A word with the opposite meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Antonyms have opposite meanings.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a compound word?
options: A word formed from two or more words or elements
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Compound words combine two or more words or elements.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a prefix?
options: An element placed before a base word
An element placed only at the end
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A prefix is added before a base word.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a suffix?
options: An element always placed before a word
An element added after a base word
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A suffix is added after a base word.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the main purpose of a paragraph?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A paragraph develops one connected idea or a closely related set of ideas.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the central idea of a passage?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: The central idea is the main point conveyed by the passage.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a summary?
options: A word-by-word copy of a text
A brief account of the main points
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A summary presents the main points concisely.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a biography?
options: An account of a person's life written by someone else
A dictionary entry for every word
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A biography describes a person's life and is written by another person.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an autobiography?
options: An account of one's own life
A story written only in dialogue
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An autobiography is an account of the author's own life.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a short story?
options: A brief work of prose fiction
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A short story is a concise work of prose fiction.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a novel?
options: A long work of prose fiction
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A novel is an extended work of prose fiction.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is drama primarily written to be?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Drama is generally written for performance, though it can also be read.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a poem commonly organized around?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Poetry is commonly arranged in lines and sometimes grouped into stanzas.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a stanza in poetry?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A stanza is a grouped set of poetic lines.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a metaphor?
options: A figurative comparison without using 'like' or 'as'
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A metaphor describes one thing in terms of another.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a simile?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A simile makes an explicit comparison, often using 'like' or 'as'.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is personification?
options: Giving human qualities to non-human things
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Personification attributes human qualities to non-human things.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is imagery in literature?
options: Language that appeals to the senses
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Imagery uses sensory language to help readers imagine an experience.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the theme of a literary work?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Theme is a central idea or concern explored in a work.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: Who is the narrator?
options: The voice that tells a story
The person who prints the book
The reader's teacher in every case
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: The narrator is the voice that tells the story.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is dialogue?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Dialogue presents spoken exchange.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a character in a story?
options: A person or being represented in the narrative
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Characters are the people or beings who take part in a story.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is setting in a story?
options: The time and place of events
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Setting establishes when and where a story occurs.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is plot?
options: The sequence and arrangement of story events
The list of characters' names only
The font used in a book
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Plot refers to the sequence and arrangement of events in a narrative.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a conflict in a story?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Conflict is a struggle that drives narrative action.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a proverb?
options: A short traditional saying expressing advice or wisdom
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A proverb is a traditional saying that conveys wisdom or advice.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an idiom?
options: An expression whose meaning may not be literal
A word always used as a name
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An idiom's overall meaning is not always predictable from its individual words.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is alliteration?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Alliteration repeats initial consonant sounds in nearby words.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is rhyme?
options: Similarity of sounds, especially at line endings
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Rhyme is a similarity of sounds, often at line endings.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a first-person narrator likely to use?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: First-person narration commonly uses 'I' or 'we'.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the purpose of a formal letter?
options: To communicate in a structured, respectful format
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Formal letters use an organized format for official or professional communication.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a notice generally meant to do?
options: Explain every word in a dictionary
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A notice gives concise information to a defined audience.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a report?
options: A stanza of four lines only
A random list of unrelated words
An organized account of an event or findings
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A report presents information in an organized manner.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the purpose of proofreading?
options: To change every noun into a verb
To make a text longer without reason
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Proofreading checks spelling, grammar, punctuation, and similar errors.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What does context help a reader do?
options: Infer a word's meaning from surrounding information
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Context can help readers infer the meaning of unfamiliar words.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an inference?
options: A conclusion drawn from clues and evidence
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An inference is a reasoned conclusion based on available evidence.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a literary genre?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Genres classify works by features such as form or subject.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is satire often used to do?
options: Criticize folly or social problems through humour or irony
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Satire uses techniques such as humour and irony to criticize behaviour or institutions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is irony?
options: A contrast between expectation and reality or intended meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Irony involves a meaningful contrast between appearance, expectation, or intended meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a protagonist?
options: The central character in a story
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: The protagonist is the central character of a narrative.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an antagonist?
options: A character or force opposing the protagonist
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An antagonist opposes the protagonist's aims.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What does a title usually do?
options: Indicate or suggest the subject of a work
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A title names a work and often signals its subject or focus.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a citation used for?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A citation identifies the source of information or ideas.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is plagiarism?
options: Presenting another's work or ideas as one's own without proper acknowledgment
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Plagiarism involves using others' work or ideas without appropriate acknowledgment.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a thesis statement?
options: A sentence expressing the central claim of an essay
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A thesis statement presents the central argument or claim.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a counterargument?
options: An opposing argument considered in a discussion
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A counterargument presents a position that challenges the main argument.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an objective tone?
options: A tone based only on insults
A tone focused on evidence rather than personal feelings
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An objective tone emphasizes evidence and avoids unnecessary personal bias.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a conclusion in an essay?
options: The closing section that brings the discussion together
The first word of the title
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A conclusion draws the discussion together and reinforces the main point.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a transition word or phrase used for?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Transitions help readers follow relationships between ideas.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is active listening?
options: Paying careful attention and responding thoughtfully
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Active listening involves attention to the speaker and thoughtful responses.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a précis?
options: A concise restatement of the essential ideas of a passage
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A précis condenses a passage while preserving its essential meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a review of a book expected to include?
options: A brief account and an evaluation
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A book review usually summarizes and evaluates the work.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a character's motivation?
options: The reason behind the character's actions
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Motivation explains why a character acts in a particular way.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a flashback?
options: A scene that presents an earlier event
A prediction of every future event
A rhyme at a line ending
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A flashback interrupts the current sequence to show an earlier event.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is foreshadowing?
options: A hint about something that may happen later
A full summary of the ending
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Foreshadowing provides clues about later developments.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a soliloquy in drama?
options: A speech in which a character speaks their thoughts aloud, often alone
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A soliloquy reveals a character's thoughts through speech, often when alone.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a stage direction?
options: An instruction about performance, movement, or setting
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Stage directions guide actors or production in performance.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a lyric poem commonly focused on?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Lyric poetry often expresses personal emotions or reflections.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an epic?
options: A long narrative poem about heroic deeds or major events
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An epic is a long narrative poem centered on heroic or culturally significant events.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a ballad traditionally associated with?
options: Narrative storytelling in verse and song
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Ballads traditionally tell stories in verse and are associated with song.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a memoir?
options: A personal account focused on selected experiences or memories
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A memoir focuses on particular experiences or periods in the author's life.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a folk tale?
options: A traditional story passed through a community
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Folk tales are traditional stories transmitted within communities.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a fable commonly intended to convey?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Fables often use characters and events to convey a moral.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a frame narrative?
options: A story structure that contains another story
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A frame narrative embeds one story within another narrative.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a reliable source?
options: A source whose accuracy and credibility can be assessed and supported
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Reliability depends on factors such as evidence, expertise, and verifiability.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a primary source?
options: A later textbook summary in every case
A source directly connected to the event or period being studied
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Primary sources provide direct evidence from or about the period or event.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a secondary source?
options: A live recording of an event only
A source that interprets or analyzes primary evidence
An original diary in every case
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Secondary sources analyze, interpret, or discuss primary sources.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a bibliography?
options: A list of sources consulted or cited
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A bibliography lists sources used or consulted.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a persuasive essay intended to do?
options: Tell a story without any claim
Support a position and influence the reader through reasons and evidence
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Persuasive writing supports a position with reasons and evidence.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a rhetorical question?
options: A question asked mainly for effect rather than an answer
A question that must always be answered numerically
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Rhetorical questions are generally used for emphasis or effect.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an oxymoron?
options: A combination of seemingly contradictory terms
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An oxymoron places apparently contradictory terms together.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is hyperbole?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Hyperbole uses intentional exaggeration.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is onomatopoeia?
options: A word with the opposite meaning
A word that imitates a sound
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Onomatopoeia uses words that imitate sounds.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a refrain in poetry or song?
options: A line or phrase repeated at intervals
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A refrain is a recurring line or phrase.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is metre in poetry?
options: A patterned rhythm of stressed and unstressed syllables
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Poetic metre organizes rhythm through patterns of syllables or stresses.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a sonnet?
options: A fixed-form poem traditionally consisting of fourteen lines
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A sonnet traditionally has fourteen lines, though forms vary.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is free verse?
options: A poem that must have fourteen lines
Poetry that does not follow a regular metre or rhyme scheme
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Free verse does not require a fixed metre or rhyme scheme.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a dramatic monologue?
options: A speech by one speaker that reveals character and situation
A conversation with exactly ten speakers
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A dramatic monologue presents one speaker's speech in a dramatic context.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an elegy?
options: A poem of mourning or reflection on loss
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An elegy is associated with lamentation or reflection on death and loss.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a sonorous effect in poetry often created by?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Sound patterns and carefully chosen words contribute to a poem's sonic effect.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the purpose of an introduction in an essay?
options: To introduce the topic and orient the reader
To list every source without context
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An introduction presents the topic and prepares readers for the discussion.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is coherence in writing?
options: Logical connection and flow among ideas
Use of the longest possible words
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Coherence helps ideas connect logically and read as a unified whole.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is cohesion in writing?
options: The linguistic links that connect sentences and parts of a text
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Cohesion is supported by linking words, references, and other textual connections.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an objective summary?
options: A review containing only personal likes
A fictional retelling with new events
A concise account that avoids inserting personal judgment
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An objective summary reports main points without adding personal opinions.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a character arc?
options: The shape of a book cover
The change a character undergoes during a story
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A character arc describes a character's development across a narrative.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a motif in literature?
options: A recurring element that contributes to meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A motif is a recurring image, idea, phrase, or element.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an unreliable narrator?
options: A narrator whose account may be incomplete or misleading
A narrator who always knows everything
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An unreliable narrator gives an account readers have reason to question.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an allegory?
options: A narrative in which characters or events convey broader symbolic meanings
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Allegory uses a narrative to represent broader ideas or meanings.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a symbol in literature?
options: Something that represents an additional idea or meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A symbol stands for or evokes something beyond its literal identity.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is tone in a literary work?
options: The author's or speaker's attitude conveyed through language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Tone reflects an attitude conveyed through diction and style.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is mood in literature?
options: The atmosphere or feeling created for the reader
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Mood is the emotional atmosphere created by a work.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an editorial?
options: An article expressing a publication's or writer's viewpoint
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An editorial presents a viewpoint on an issue.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a headline designed to do?
options: Summarize or attract attention to a news item
Provide the full text of an article
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A headline identifies the topic and attracts readers' attention.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is fact-checking?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Fact-checking compares claims with evidence and credible sources.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is bias in a text?
options: A tendency to present information from a particular perspective
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Bias can influence which facts or viewpoints a text emphasizes.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a register in language?
options: A variety of language used in a particular context or situation
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Register refers to language choices suited to a social or communicative setting.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is code-switching?
options: Alternating between languages or varieties in communication
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Code-switching involves shifting between languages or language varieties.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a dialect?
options: A language variety associated with a region or social group
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Dialects may differ in pronunciation, vocabulary, and grammar.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is transliteration?
options: Representing text from one script using another script
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Transliteration represents characters or sounds in another writing system.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is translation?
options: Rendering meaning from one language into another
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Translation conveys a text's meaning in another language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a literal translation?
options: A translation that intentionally changes the plot
A close, word-oriented rendering of the source text
A summary with no source meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Literal translation follows the source wording closely, though it may sound unnatural.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is localization?
options: Adapting content for a particular language and cultural audience
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Localization adapts content to the target audience's linguistic and cultural context.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a loanword?
options: A word used only in poetry
A word adopted from another language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Loanwords enter a language through contact with other languages.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is etymology?
options: The study of word origins and histories
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Etymology studies the origins and historical development of words.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a corpus in linguistics?
options: A structured collection of language data
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A corpus is a collection of language samples used for analysis.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is phonology concerned with?
options: Sound systems and sound patterns in a language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Phonology studies how sounds function and pattern within a language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is morphology concerned with?
options: The structure and formation of words
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Morphology examines word structure and meaningful parts.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is syntax concerned with?
options: The colour of a book cover
How words combine into phrases and sentences
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Syntax studies the structure of phrases and sentences.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is semantics concerned with?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Semantics studies linguistic meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is pragmatics concerned with?
options: Meaning in context and language use
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Pragmatics examines how context affects interpretation and communication.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a minimal pair in phonology?
options: Two words differing in one sound and having different meanings
Two sentences with the same punctuation
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Minimal pairs help demonstrate sound contrasts in a language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a morpheme?
options: The smallest unit carrying grammatical or lexical meaning
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A morpheme is a minimal meaningful unit in language.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an inflection?
options: A grammatical change marking features such as tense, number, or case
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Inflection changes a word form to express grammatical information.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a clause?
options: A grammatical unit containing a predicate and usually a subject
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A clause contains a predicate and commonly a subject.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a complex sentence?
options: A sentence consisting only of a title
A sentence with one independent clause and at least one dependent clause
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A complex sentence includes an independent clause and one or more dependent clauses.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is direct speech?
options: The exact words spoken, presented as speech
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Direct speech represents a speaker's words as spoken.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is reported speech?
options: A retelling of what someone said without quoting the exact words
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Reported speech conveys another person's words or message indirectly.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a transitive verb?
options: A verb that takes a direct object
A verb that never appears in a sentence
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A transitive verb can take a direct object.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an intransitive verb?
options: A verb that does not take a direct object
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An intransitive verb does not take a direct object.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is subject-verb agreement?
options: Using the same rhyme in every line
Matching a title to a cover
Matching a verb with its subject in relevant grammatical features
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Subject-verb agreement means the verb form is appropriate for its subject.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a compound sentence?
options: A sentence containing two or more independent clauses
A word formed from two letters
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A compound sentence joins independent clauses.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an imperative sentence commonly used for?
options: Giving a command, instruction, or request
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Imperatives are used for commands, instructions, or requests.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an interrogative sentence?
options: A sentence that always gives a command
A sentence that asks a question
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An interrogative sentence asks a question.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an exclamatory sentence?
options: A sentence that only names a place
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Exclamatory sentences express strong emotion or emphasis.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a declarative sentence?
options: A sentence that asks a question
A sentence that makes a statement
A sentence that gives a command only
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A declarative sentence states information or an idea.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a conjunction used for?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Conjunctions connect grammatical units.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a synonym dictionary useful for?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A synonym dictionary helps find words with similar meanings.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a dictionary headword?
options: The word listed as an entry for explanation
The last word in every paragraph
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A headword is the main word under which a dictionary entry appears.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is alphabetical order?
options: Arranging items according to the sequence of letters
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Alphabetical order follows the established sequence of letters.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a reading strategy called skimming?
options: Reading quickly to get the general idea
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Skimming helps a reader grasp the general idea quickly.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is scanning in reading?
options: Searching a text for a specific detail
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Scanning is used to locate specific information quickly.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is close reading?
options: Careful analysis of a text's details and language
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Close reading examines textual details and how they create meaning.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a theme statement?
options: A sentence expressing the broader message or insight of a work
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A theme statement expresses a general insight explored by the work.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a text's audience?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Audience refers to the people for whom a text is intended.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is purpose in communication?
options: The reason a message is created
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Purpose explains what the communicator intends to achieve.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an interview?
options: A structured exchange of questions and answers
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An interview gathers or shares information through questions and answers.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a speech outline used for?
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: An outline organizes a speech's ideas in a logical order.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a debate?
options: A story with one narrator only
A structured discussion of opposing viewpoints
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: Debate presents and examines opposing arguments under agreed rules.

CBSE 12 - Malayalam.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a claim in argumentation?
options: A statement whose validity is supported with reasons or evidence
CBSE 12 - Malayalam.why: A claim is a position that an argument seeks to support.

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.q: ‘फलानि’ शब्द किस वचन में है?

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.q: ‘गच्छति’ किस पुरुष और वचन का रूप है?
CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.why: ‘गच्छति’ लट् लकार, प्रथम पुरुष, एकवचन का रूप है।

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.q: ‘पठामि’ किस पुरुष और वचन का रूप है?
CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.why: ‘पठामि’ लट् लकार, उत्तम पुरुष, एकवचन का रूप है।

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.q: ‘रामेण’ में कौन-सी विभक्ति है?
CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.why: ‘रामेण’ तृतीया एकवचन रूप है, जिसका अर्थ ‘राम द्वारा/राम से’ हो सकता है।

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.q: ‘गुरवे’ सामान्यतः किस विभक्ति का रूप है?
CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.why: ‘गुरवे’ ‘गुरु’ शब्द का चतुर्थी एकवचन रूप है।

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.q: ‘वृक्षात्’ किस विभक्ति का एकवचन रूप है?
CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.why: ‘वृक्षात्’ पञ्चमी एकवचन रूप है, जो अपादान/‘से’ का अर्थ दे सकता है।

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.q: ‘नदीषु’ किस विभक्ति और वचन का रूप है?
CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.why: ‘नदीषु’ सप्तमी बहुवचन है: नदियों में।

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.q: ‘बालकौ’ किस वचन को दर्शाता है?
CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.why: ‘बालकौ’ पुल्लिंग ‘बालक’ का प्रथमा/द्वितीया द्विवचन रूप हो सकता है।

CBSE 12 - Sanskrit Core.why: ‘खादन्ति’ प्रथम पुरुष बहुवचन का रूप है: वे खाते हैं।
