Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Transition words show relationships such as contrast, sequence, or cause and effect.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is chronological order?
options: Arranging events by when they occur
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Chronological order organizes events according to time.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an inference?
options: A conclusion drawn from clues and evidence
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An inference is a conclusion based on clues and evidence.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is skimming?
options: Reading quickly to grasp the general idea
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Skimming is rapid reading to understand the overall idea.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is scanning?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Scanning means searching a text for particular details.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an idiom?
options: An expression whose meaning may not be literal
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An idiom is a fixed expression with a conventional meaning that may not be literal.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is denotation?
options: The basic or literal meaning of a word
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Denotation is a word’s direct or literal meaning.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is connotation?
options: Associations or feelings linked to a word
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Connotation refers to associations beyond literal meaning.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a loanword?
options: A word adopted from another language
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A loanword is borrowed from another language.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is transliteration?
options: Representing words from one script in another script
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Transliteration represents writing from one script using another script.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: How does translation differ from transliteration?
options: Translation conveys meaning; transliteration represents a form in another script
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Translation conveys meaning in another language; transliteration represents a written form in another script.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Which language family does Punjabi belong to?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Punjabi is an Indo-Aryan language within the Indo-European family.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Which region is most closely associated with Punjabi’s historical homeland?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Punjabi is historically associated with the Punjab region.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Which is a common Punjabi greeting?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ is a widely used Punjabi greeting.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does ਧੰਨਵਾਦ mean?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: ਧੰਨਵਾਦ means thank you.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਕੇ mean?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਕੇ means please.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does ਮਾਫ਼ ਕਰਨਾ commonly mean?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: ਮਾਫ਼ ਕਰਨਾ can mean excuse me or forgive me, depending on context.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a dictionary used for?
options: To explain word meanings and usage
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A dictionary gives word meanings and often spelling, pronunciation, and usage.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a thesaurus used for?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A thesaurus groups synonyms and related words.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a formal application?
options: A written request to an authority
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An application is a formal written request.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the purpose of a title?
options: To indicate a text’s topic or focus
To provide only an answer key
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A title indicates the topic or focus of a text.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a good speech usually organized around?
options: A clear message and logically ordered points
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An effective speech has a clear message and organized points.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a debate?
options: A structured discussion of opposing viewpoints
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A debate examines opposing positions on a topic.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is active listening?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Active listening involves attention, understanding, and relevant responses.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a meeting agenda?
options: A list of planned topics for discussion
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An agenda outlines topics planned for a meeting.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What are meeting minutes?
options: A poem written during a meeting
A record of key discussions and decisions
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Meeting minutes record important discussion points and decisions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a press release?
options: An official announcement for media or public distribution
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A press release communicates an announcement to media or the public.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a slogan?
options: A short memorable phrase expressing a message
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A slogan is a short, memorable phrase expressing an idea or promoting a cause.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is bias in a text?
options: A tendency to favour one perspective
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Bias is a tendency to favour a viewpoint or side.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a fact?
options: A claim that can be checked against evidence
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A fact can be checked or verified using evidence.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an opinion?
options: A measurable fact in every case
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An opinion expresses a viewpoint or judgment.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a primary source?
options: An original work or direct record being studied
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A primary source is the original text or direct record relevant to a study.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a secondary source?
options: The original poem in every case
A work that analyzes or discusses primary sources
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A secondary source interprets or discusses primary material.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an index in a book used for?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An index helps readers find topics, names, and terms by page reference.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an appendix?
options: Supplementary material placed after the main text
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An appendix contains supplementary material at the end of a work.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a footnote?
options: A note at the bottom of a page with extra information or a citation
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A footnote provides additional information or source details at the bottom of a page.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a research question?
options: A final answer with no inquiry
A focused question guiding an investigation
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A research question defines what an investigation seeks to understand.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a learning outcome?
options: What a learner should know or be able to demonstrate
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Learning outcomes describe knowledge or skills students should demonstrate.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a syllabus?
options: A document outlining course topics and requirements
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A syllabus sets out the content and requirements for a course or exam.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should a Punjabi question bank be checked against the official syllabus?
options: To ensure it matches prescribed texts and requirements
To guarantee every item appears in the exam
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Syllabus checking helps align practice material with prescribed course requirements.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a single-best-answer MCQ?
options: A question with no intended answer
A question with one option that best answers the prompt
A question with four correct options
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A single-best-answer item has one intended best answer.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should wording variants be labelled?
options: To distinguish rephrased items from distinct questions
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Labelling variants is transparent and shows how much distinct coverage the bank contains.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is JSON commonly used for?
options: Representing structured data in text form
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: JSON is a text-based format used to exchange structured data.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a JSON array?
options: An ordered list of values in square brackets
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A JSON array is an ordered list enclosed in square brackets.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should a JSON question bank be validated?
options: To prove the questions are official
To catch syntax and field errors before import
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Validation catches malformed JSON and unexpected fields before import.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does answer_index typically represent?
options: The position of the correct option in the options array
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An answer index identifies the correct option’s position in the options list.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why is UTF-8 useful for a Punjabi JSON file?
options: It converts all text to English
It supports Unicode text such as Gurmukhi characters
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: UTF-8 supports Unicode text such as Gurmukhi characters when handled correctly.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a language’s standard variety?
options: A variety used as a reference in formal settings and education
The only variety spoken by everyone
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A standard variety is commonly used as a reference in formal communication and education.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is language variation?
options: Differences across regions, communities, or situations
A rule that everyone must sound identical
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Language varies across regions, communities, and contexts.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is language preservation concerned with?
options: Supporting continued use and transmission of a language
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Language preservation supports ongoing use, teaching, documentation, and transmission.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is oral tradition?
options: Passing stories, songs, or knowledge through spoken transmission
Printing every text in a newspaper
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Oral tradition transmits cultural knowledge and creative works through speech and performance.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why are folk songs useful for cultural study?
options: They can preserve community memories, values, and practices
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Folk songs can reflect and preserve community memories, values, and practices.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a literary genre?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Genre classifies literary works by form or type.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a dramatic monologue?
options: A speech by one character revealing thoughts or character
A conversation among many speakers only
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A dramatic monologue is an extended speech by one speaker that reveals character or viewpoint.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a soliloquy?
options: A group chorus in every case
A character speaking thoughts aloud, often alone on stage
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A soliloquy lets a character express inner thoughts aloud, often while alone.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a memoir?
options: A fictional poem in every case
A personal account focused on selected life experiences
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A memoir recounts selected personal experiences or periods of life.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a travelogue?
options: An account of travel experiences and places visited
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A travelogue describes journeys, places, and experiences.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a refrain?
options: A line or phrase repeated at intervals in a poem or song
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A refrain is a line or phrase that recurs in a song or poem.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a rhyme scheme?
options: The pattern of end rhymes in a poem
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A rhyme scheme describes the pattern of rhyming line endings.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is free verse?
options: Poetry that must rhyme every line
Poetry without a fixed traditional metre or rhyme scheme
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Free verse does not follow a fixed traditional metre or rhyme scheme.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an elegy?
options: A poem of mourning or reflection on loss
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An elegy is a poem of mourning, loss, or solemn reflection.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an ode?
options: A poem expressing praise or serious reflection
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An ode is a lyric poem that often praises or reflects on a subject.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a sonnet traditionally?
options: A paragraph with fourteen sentences always
A poem consisting of fourteen lines
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A sonnet is traditionally a fourteen-line poetic form.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is irony?
options: A contrast between expectation and reality or intended and literal meaning
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Irony involves a meaningful contrast between expectation, words, or events and the actual situation or intent.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an oxymoron?
options: A phrase combining apparently contradictory terms
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An oxymoron combines terms that appear contradictory.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is onomatopoeia?
options: A word with the opposite meaning
A word that imitates a sound
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Onomatopoeia uses words that imitate sounds.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a euphemism?
options: A mild or indirect expression replacing a harsher one
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A euphemism softens or indirectly expresses something that may seem harsh.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a character sketch?
options: A description of a character’s traits and behaviour
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A character sketch describes a character’s personality, behaviour, and qualities.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a plot’s resolution?
options: The part where the main conflict is settled or brought toward closure
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Resolution brings the main conflict or narrative strands toward closure.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is foreshadowing?
options: A hint about an event that may occur later
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Foreshadowing provides hints about later events in a narrative.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a subtext?
options: An implied meaning beneath the explicit words
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Subtext is meaning implied rather than directly stated.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the purpose of a character’s motivation analysis?
options: To explain why the character acts in a particular way
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Motivation explains why a character acts in a particular way.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a reflective essay?
options: An essay examining experiences and what the writer learned
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A reflective essay explores experiences, responses, and learning.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a descriptive essay intended to do?
options: Create a clear picture of a subject using relevant details
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Descriptive writing uses details to help readers imagine a subject.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a narrative essay intended to do?
options: Tell a sequence of events or an experience
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Narrative writing tells events in a sequence.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an expository essay intended to do?
options: Explain or inform about a topic
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Expository writing explains or informs using organized information.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a persuasive appeal to emotion called?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Pathos is an appeal to the audience’s emotions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an appeal to credibility called?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Ethos appeals to a speaker’s credibility or character.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an appeal to reasoning called?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Logos appeals to logic and reasoning.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a rhetorical question often used for?
options: To emphasize a point or prompt thought
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Rhetorical questions often emphasize a point or invite reflection.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a fact-check intended to do?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Fact-checking tests claims against credible evidence and sources.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is misinformation?
options: False or inaccurate information, whether deliberate or not
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Misinformation is false or inaccurate information, regardless of intent.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is disinformation?
options: False information spread deliberately to mislead
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Disinformation is false information shared with the intention to deceive.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a source’s credibility?
options: The number of words in its title
How trustworthy and reliable it is
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Credibility concerns the reliability and trustworthiness of a source.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should a source’s date be checked?
options: Dates always prove a source false
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Dates help judge whether information is current for the task.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a questionnaire designed to do?
options: Replace all interviews in every situation
Collect responses to a set of questions
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A questionnaire collects information through a structured set of questions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a formal invitation expected to include?
options: Event, date, time, place, and host or contact
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Invitations usually include event details such as date, time, venue, and host.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a complaint letter intended to do?
options: Describe a problem and request appropriate action
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A complaint letter explains a problem and asks for a remedy or response.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a suitable formal letter closing?
options: A polite sign-off suited to the context
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A formal letter ends with a polite closing appropriate to its recipient and purpose.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the purpose of an advertisement?
options: To inform, persuade, or promote a product, service, or idea
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Advertisements are designed to inform, persuade, or promote.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is media literacy?
options: The ability to analyze, evaluate, and create media messages
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Media literacy involves understanding and evaluating media messages.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is an audience in communication?
options: The people receiving or listening to a message
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: The audience is the intended or actual receiver of a message.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is feedback in communication?
options: A response indicating how a message was received or understood
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Feedback provides information about the receiver’s response or understanding.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is empathy?
options: Trying to understand another person’s perspective or feelings
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Empathy involves considering another person’s perspective and feelings.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a respectful disagreement?
options: Disagreeing with an idea while treating the person courteously
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Respectful disagreement focuses on ideas and reasons rather than personal attacks.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is active recall?
options: Retrieving learned information from memory without looking at the answer
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Active recall means retrieving learned information from memory.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is spaced practice?
options: Reviewing material over multiple sessions separated in time
Studying only once at the last minute
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Spaced practice distributes review over time and supports retention.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a study schedule for?
options: Planning study tasks and time realistically
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A study schedule helps allocate time and organize tasks.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a formative assessment?
options: An assessment during learning used to guide improvement
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Formative assessment provides feedback during learning so students can improve.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a summative assessment?
options: An assessment evaluating learning at the end of a unit or period
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Summative assessment evaluates learning after a unit or period of instruction.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a marking scheme?
options: A guide describing how marks are awarded
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A marking scheme sets out criteria or allocation of marks for responses.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a good strategy for a long-answer exam question?
options: Plan the answer and organize points logically
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Planning helps ensure a complete, relevant, logically organized answer.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does “compare” generally ask a student to do?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Compare asks for similarities and, where relevant, differences between items.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does “analyse” generally require?
options: Break a topic into parts and explain how they relate
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Analysis examines parts, relationships, and how or why something works.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does “evaluate” generally ask?
options: Make a reasoned judgment using criteria or evidence
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Evaluation requires a judgment supported by criteria or evidence.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does “justify” require?
options: Support a claim or choice with reasons or evidence
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Justify means give reasons or evidence supporting a claim or decision.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does “concise” mean?
options: Expressing the needed meaning in few clear words
Using as many words as possible
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Concise writing communicates without unnecessary words.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What does “precise” mean in writing?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Precise wording is specific and accurate.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a topic sentence’s supporting detail?
options: Information or evidence that develops the main point
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Supporting details explain, illustrate, or provide evidence for a paragraph’s main point.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the purpose of a quotation in an essay?
options: To use exact words from a source with attribution
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Quotations use exact wording from a source and should be attributed.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a source citation used for?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A citation identifies the source of borrowed information or ideas.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a reliable way to check spelling?
options: Consult a trusted dictionary or reference
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A trusted dictionary or reference helps verify spelling.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a good reason to reread a difficult passage?
options: To clarify meaning and notice missed details
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Rereading can improve comprehension and reveal important details.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is annotation?
options: Adding brief notes, marks, or questions to a text
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Annotation records observations, questions, and key ideas alongside a text.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a language portfolio?
options: A collection of work samples showing learning progress
A list of exam dates only
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A portfolio collects work samples and evidence of development over time.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is self-assessment?
options: Evaluating one’s own work against criteria
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Self-assessment compares work with criteria to identify strengths and areas for improvement.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is constructive feedback?
options: Specific guidance that helps improve performance
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Constructive feedback identifies strengths and actionable areas for improvement.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the purpose of a sample paper?
options: Practising exam format, timing, and question types
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Sample papers help practise format and time management but do not guarantee exact questions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a unique question in a question bank?
options: An item testing a distinct prompt or concept, not merely reworded
Any repeated item with a new ID
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A genuinely distinct item differs meaningfully in what it asks or assesses.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a question ID used for?
options: Identifying and managing an item uniquely
Indicating the correct answer by itself
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A question ID uniquely identifies a record in the dataset.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a topic field used for in an MCQ dataset?
options: Categorizing questions for filtering and balanced practice
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Topic labels help organize, filter, and balance questions across areas.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a difficulty field used for?
options: Labelling an item’s estimated challenge level
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Difficulty labels help organize practice, though they are estimates unless tested.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the purpose of an explanation in an MCQ?
options: To show why the correct choice fits the question
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Explanations help learners understand the reasoning behind the correct answer.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the safest description of a question bank without syllabus verification?
options: General practice material, not verified as an official syllabus match
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Without checking the current syllabus, it should be described as general practice material.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should answer options be plausible but incorrect when they are distractors?
options: They assess understanding rather than recognition of silly options
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Plausible distractors can reveal misconceptions and make questions more diagnostic.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should a question bank be updated periodically?
options: To correct errors and maintain relevance
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Periodic review helps correct errors and maintain relevance.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a JSON object?
options: A collection of key-value pairs enclosed in braces
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A JSON object contains key-value pairs enclosed in braces.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a JSON string?
options: Text enclosed in double quotation marks
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A JSON string is text enclosed in double quotation marks.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should Punjabi script display be checked in an app?
options: To ensure Unicode text and fonts render correctly
To change every question to English
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Font and Unicode support are needed to display Gurmukhi correctly.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should a language question specify the script when relevant?
options: Script requirements affect reading, writing, and assessment
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Course materials may require a particular script, so the requirement should be clear.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the difference between language and script?
options: A language can have no spoken form
Language is a communication system; script is a writing system used to represent it
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Language and script are related but distinct concepts.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the purpose of a prescribed textbook?
options: To be the only source in every situation
To guarantee every question appears in an exam
To provide course material selected for the curriculum
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A prescribed textbook supports the curriculum, while the syllabus defines required scope.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is assessment alignment?
options: Matching questions to intended learning outcomes
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Assessment alignment means tasks measure the intended learning outcomes.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should questions avoid ambiguous wording?
options: Clear wording assesses knowledge rather than guesswork
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Ambiguous wording can confuse learners and weaken assessment validity.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a pilot test of a question bank?
options: Trying items with learners to check clarity and performance
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Pilot testing can reveal ambiguous items and show how questions perform.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the purpose of a changelog?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A changelog records what changed between versions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is data provenance?
options: Information about where data came from and how it was produced
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Data provenance documents the origin and history of data.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a schema in a JSON question bank?
options: A definition of expected fields and data types
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A schema describes the structure and expected data types of JSON records.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a good strategy after answering a practice question incorrectly?
options: Review the concept and understand the error
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Reviewing the concept and error helps prevent repeated mistakes.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why should a literature answer refer to the specific text?
options: To keep the interpretation accurate and relevant
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Naming and discussing the text keeps interpretation grounded and relevant.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is the best way to discuss a poem’s imagery?
options: Identify an image and explain its effect or meaning
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Analysis connects a specific image to its effect or meaning.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a good way to compare two poems?
options: Discuss relevant similarities and differences with details
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A comparison should address relevant features of both poems and support points with details.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Why is cultural context useful in reading?
options: It helps explain references, assumptions, and meanings
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Cultural context can illuminate references and meanings in a text.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is historical context?
options: The events and conditions surrounding a text’s creation
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Historical context concerns the circumstances surrounding a text’s creation.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a literary adaptation?
options: Reworking a story or work into a new form or context
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An adaptation reinterprets material for a different form, audience, or context.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a language learner’s receptive skill?
options: Understanding language through listening or reading
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Receptive skills include listening and reading.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: What is a productive language skill?
options: Speaking or writing to communicate meaning
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Productive skills include speaking and writing.

Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Meeting minutes record important discussion points and decisions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a press release?
options: An official announcement for media or public distribution
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A press release communicates an announcement to media or the public.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a slogan?
options: A short memorable phrase expressing a message
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A slogan is a short, memorable phrase expressing an idea or promoting a cause.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is bias in a text?
options: A tendency to favour one perspective
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Bias is a tendency to favour a viewpoint or side.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a fact?
options: A claim that can be checked against evidence
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A fact can be checked or verified using evidence.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an opinion?
options: A measurable fact in every case
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An opinion expresses a viewpoint or judgment.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a primary source?
options: An original work or direct record being studied
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A primary source is the original text or direct record relevant to a study.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a secondary source?
options: The original poem in every case
A work that analyzes or discusses primary sources
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A secondary source interprets or discusses primary material.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an index in a book used for?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An index helps readers find topics, names, and terms by page reference.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an appendix?
options: Supplementary material placed after the main text
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An appendix contains supplementary material at the end of a work.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a footnote?
options: A note at the bottom of a page with extra information or a citation
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A footnote provides additional information or source details at the bottom of a page.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a research question?
options: A final answer with no inquiry
A focused question guiding an investigation
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A research question defines what an investigation seeks to understand.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a learning outcome?
options: What a learner should know or be able to demonstrate
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Learning outcomes describe knowledge or skills students should demonstrate.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a syllabus?
options: A document outlining course topics and requirements
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A syllabus sets out the content and requirements for a course or exam.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: Why should a Punjabi question bank be checked against the official syllabus?
options: To guarantee every item appears in the exam
To ensure it matches prescribed texts and requirements
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Syllabus checking helps align practice material with prescribed course requirements.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a single-best-answer MCQ?
options: A question with one option that best answers the prompt
A question with no intended answer
A question with four correct options
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A single-best-answer item has one intended best answer.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: Why should wording variants be labelled?
options: To distinguish rephrased items from distinct questions
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Labelling variants is transparent and shows how much distinct coverage the bank contains.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is JSON commonly used for?
options: Representing structured data in text form
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: JSON is a text-based format used to exchange structured data.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a JSON array?
options: An ordered list of values in square brackets
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A JSON array is an ordered list enclosed in square brackets.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: Why should a JSON question bank be validated?
options: To catch syntax and field errors before import
To prove the questions are official
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Validation catches malformed JSON and unexpected fields before import.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What does answer_index typically represent?
options: The position of the correct option in the options array
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An answer index identifies the correct option’s position in the options list.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: Why is UTF-8 useful for a Punjabi JSON file?
options: It converts all text to English
It supports Unicode text such as Gurmukhi characters
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: UTF-8 supports Unicode text such as Gurmukhi characters when handled correctly.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a language’s standard variety?
options: A variety used as a reference in formal settings and education
The only variety spoken by everyone
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A standard variety is commonly used as a reference in formal communication and education.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is language variation?
options: A rule that everyone must sound identical
Differences across regions, communities, or situations
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Language varies across regions, communities, and contexts.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is language preservation concerned with?
options: Supporting continued use and transmission of a language
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Language preservation supports ongoing use, teaching, documentation, and transmission.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is oral tradition?
options: Printing every text in a newspaper
Passing stories, songs, or knowledge through spoken transmission
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Oral tradition transmits cultural knowledge and creative works through speech and performance.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: Why are folk songs useful for cultural study?
options: They can preserve community memories, values, and practices
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Folk songs can reflect and preserve community memories, values, and practices.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a literary genre?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Genre classifies literary works by form or type.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a dramatic monologue?
options: A conversation among many speakers only
A speech by one character revealing thoughts or character
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A dramatic monologue is an extended speech by one speaker that reveals character or viewpoint.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a soliloquy?
options: A character speaking thoughts aloud, often alone on stage
A group chorus in every case
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A soliloquy lets a character express inner thoughts aloud, often while alone.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a memoir?
options: A personal account focused on selected life experiences
A fictional poem in every case
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A memoir recounts selected personal experiences or periods of life.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a travelogue?
options: An account of travel experiences and places visited
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A travelogue describes journeys, places, and experiences.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a refrain?
options: A line or phrase repeated at intervals in a poem or song
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A refrain is a line or phrase that recurs in a song or poem.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a rhyme scheme?
options: The pattern of end rhymes in a poem
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A rhyme scheme describes the pattern of rhyming line endings.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is free verse?
options: Poetry that must rhyme every line
Poetry without a fixed traditional metre or rhyme scheme
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Free verse does not follow a fixed traditional metre or rhyme scheme.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an elegy?
options: A poem of mourning or reflection on loss
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An elegy is a poem of mourning, loss, or solemn reflection.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an ode?
options: A poem expressing praise or serious reflection
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An ode is a lyric poem that often praises or reflects on a subject.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a sonnet traditionally?
options: A poem consisting of fourteen lines
A paragraph with fourteen sentences always
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A sonnet is traditionally a fourteen-line poetic form.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is irony?
options: A contrast between expectation and reality or intended and literal meaning
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Irony involves a meaningful contrast between expectation, words, or events and the actual situation or intent.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an oxymoron?
options: A phrase combining apparently contradictory terms
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: An oxymoron combines terms that appear contradictory.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is onomatopoeia?
options: A word that imitates a sound
A word with the opposite meaning
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Onomatopoeia uses words that imitate sounds.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a euphemism?
options: A mild or indirect expression replacing a harsher one
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A euphemism softens or indirectly expresses something that may seem harsh.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a character sketch?
options: A description of a character’s traits and behaviour
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A character sketch describes a character’s personality, behaviour, and qualities.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a plot’s resolution?
options: The part where the main conflict is settled or brought toward closure
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Resolution brings the main conflict or narrative strands toward closure.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is foreshadowing?
options: A hint about an event that may occur later
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Foreshadowing provides hints about later events in a narrative.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a subtext?
options: An implied meaning beneath the explicit words
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Subtext is meaning implied rather than directly stated.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the purpose of a character’s motivation analysis?
options: To explain why the character acts in a particular way
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Motivation explains why a character acts in a particular way.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a reflective essay?
options: An essay examining experiences and what the writer learned
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A reflective essay explores experiences, responses, and learning.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a descriptive essay intended to do?
options: Create a clear picture of a subject using relevant details
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Descriptive writing uses details to help readers imagine a subject.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a narrative essay intended to do?
options: Tell a sequence of events or an experience
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Narrative writing tells events in a sequence.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an expository essay intended to do?
options: Explain or inform about a topic
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Expository writing explains or informs using organized information.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a persuasive appeal to emotion called?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Pathos is an appeal to the audience’s emotions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an appeal to credibility called?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Ethos appeals to a speaker’s credibility or character.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an appeal to reasoning called?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Logos appeals to logic and reasoning.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a rhetorical question often used for?
options: To emphasize a point or prompt thought
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Rhetorical questions often emphasize a point or invite reflection.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a fact-check intended to do?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Fact-checking tests claims against credible evidence and sources.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is misinformation?
options: False or inaccurate information, whether deliberate or not
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Misinformation is false or inaccurate information, regardless of intent.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is disinformation?
options: False information spread deliberately to mislead
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Disinformation is false information shared with the intention to deceive.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a source’s credibility?
options: How trustworthy and reliable it is
The number of words in its title
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Credibility concerns the reliability and trustworthiness of a source.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: Why should a source’s date be checked?
options: Dates always prove a source false
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Dates help judge whether information is current for the task.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a questionnaire designed to do?
options: Collect responses to a set of questions
Replace all interviews in every situation
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A questionnaire collects information through a structured set of questions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a formal invitation expected to include?
options: Event, date, time, place, and host or contact
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Invitations usually include event details such as date, time, venue, and host.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a complaint letter intended to do?
options: Describe a problem and request appropriate action
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A complaint letter explains a problem and asks for a remedy or response.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a suitable formal letter closing?
options: A polite sign-off suited to the context
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A formal letter ends with a polite closing appropriate to its recipient and purpose.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the purpose of an advertisement?
options: To inform, persuade, or promote a product, service, or idea
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Advertisements are designed to inform, persuade, or promote.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is media literacy?
options: The ability to analyze, evaluate, and create media messages
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Media literacy involves understanding and evaluating media messages.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is an audience in communication?
options: The people receiving or listening to a message
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: The audience is the intended or actual receiver of a message.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is feedback in communication?
options: A response indicating how a message was received or understood
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Feedback provides information about the receiver’s response or understanding.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is empathy?
options: Trying to understand another person’s perspective or feelings
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Empathy involves considering another person’s perspective and feelings.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a respectful disagreement?
options: Disagreeing with an idea while treating the person courteously
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Respectful disagreement focuses on ideas and reasons rather than personal attacks.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is active recall?
options: Retrieving learned information from memory without looking at the answer
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Active recall means retrieving learned information from memory.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is spaced practice?
options: Reviewing material over multiple sessions separated in time
Studying only once at the last minute
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Spaced practice distributes review over time and supports retention.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a study schedule for?
options: Planning study tasks and time realistically
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A study schedule helps allocate time and organize tasks.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a formative assessment?
options: An assessment during learning used to guide improvement
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Formative assessment provides feedback during learning so students can improve.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a summative assessment?
options: An assessment evaluating learning at the end of a unit or period
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Summative assessment evaluates learning after a unit or period of instruction.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a marking scheme?
options: A guide describing how marks are awarded
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A marking scheme sets out criteria or allocation of marks for responses.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a good strategy for a long-answer exam question?
options: Plan the answer and organize points logically
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Planning helps ensure a complete, relevant, logically organized answer.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What does “compare” generally ask a student to do?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Compare asks for similarities and, where relevant, differences between items.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What does “analyse” generally require?
options: Break a topic into parts and explain how they relate
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Analysis examines parts, relationships, and how or why something works.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What does “evaluate” generally ask?
options: Make a reasoned judgment using criteria or evidence
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Evaluation requires a judgment supported by criteria or evidence.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What does “justify” require?
options: Support a claim or choice with reasons or evidence
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Justify means give reasons or evidence supporting a claim or decision.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What does “concise” mean?
options: Expressing the needed meaning in few clear words
Using as many words as possible
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Concise writing communicates without unnecessary words.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What does “precise” mean in writing?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Precise wording is specific and accurate.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a topic sentence’s supporting detail?
options: Information or evidence that develops the main point
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Supporting details explain, illustrate, or provide evidence for a paragraph’s main point.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the purpose of a quotation in an essay?
options: To use exact words from a source with attribution
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Quotations use exact wording from a source and should be attributed.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a source citation used for?
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A citation identifies the source of borrowed information or ideas.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a reliable way to check spelling?
options: Consult a trusted dictionary or reference
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A trusted dictionary or reference helps verify spelling.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a good reason to reread a difficult passage?
options: To clarify meaning and notice missed details
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Rereading can improve comprehension and reveal important details.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is annotation?
options: Adding brief notes, marks, or questions to a text
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Annotation records observations, questions, and key ideas alongside a text.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a language portfolio?
options: A list of exam dates only
A collection of work samples showing learning progress
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A portfolio collects work samples and evidence of development over time.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is self-assessment?
options: Evaluating one’s own work against criteria
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Self-assessment compares work with criteria to identify strengths and areas for improvement.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is constructive feedback?
options: Specific guidance that helps improve performance
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Constructive feedback identifies strengths and actionable areas for improvement.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is the purpose of a sample paper?
options: Practising exam format, timing, and question types
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Sample papers help practise format and time management but do not guarantee exact questions.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a unique question in a question bank?
options: Any repeated item with a new ID
An item testing a distinct prompt or concept, not merely reworded
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A genuinely distinct item differs meaningfully in what it asks or assesses.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a question ID used for?
options: Indicating the correct answer by itself
Identifying and managing an item uniquely
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: A question ID uniquely identifies a record in the dataset.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a topic field used for in an MCQ dataset?
options: Categorizing questions for filtering and balanced practice
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Topic labels help organize, filter, and balance questions across areas.

Class 12 - Punjabi.q: Choose the correct answer: What is a difficulty field used for?
options: Labelling an item’s estimated challenge level
Class 12 - Punjabi.why: Difficulty labels help organize practice, though they are estimates unless tested.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాష్ట్ర రాజధాని ఏది?

Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: తెలుగు భాషకు ప్రత్యేకమైన తెలుగు లిపి ఉంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: సాంప్రదాయ తెలుగు వర్ణమాలలో సాధారణంగా 16 అచ్చులు బోధిస్తారు; పాఠ్యపుస్తక విధానాన్ని బట్టి వివరాలు మారవచ్చు.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: తెలుగులో హల్లులు సాధారణంగా ఎన్ని?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: సాంప్రదాయ తెలుగు వర్ణమాలలో 36 హల్లులు అని సాధారణంగా బోధిస్తారు.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ‘అమ్మ’ అనే పదానికి అర్థం ఏమిటి?
‘నాన్న’ అనే పదానికి అర్థం ఏమిటి?
‘నీరు’ అనే పదానికి సమానార్థక పదం ఏది?
‘ఆకాశం’ అనే పదానికి సమానార్థకం ఏది?
‘సంతోషం’కు వ్యతిరేక పదం ఏది?
‘పెద్ద’కు వ్యతిరేక పదం ఏది?
‘వేగంగా’ అనే పదానికి దగ్గర అర్థం ఏది?
‘పుస్తకం’ బహువచనం ఏది?
‘బాలుడు’ స్త్రీలింగ రూపం ఏది?
‘నేను పాఠశాలకు వెళ్తాను’ వాక్యంలో కర్త ఎవరు?
‘రాముడు పుస్తకం చదివాడు’ వాక్యంలో క్రియ ఏది?

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ‘అయ్యో!’ అనే పదం ఏ భావాన్ని తెలియజేస్తుంది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: ‘అయ్యో!’ సందర్భాన్ని బట్టి బాధ లేదా ఆశ్చర్యాన్ని తెలియజేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ‘మంచి’కు వ్యతిరేక పదం ఏది?
‘వెలుగు’కు వ్యతిరేక పదం ఏది?
‘గురువు’కు సమానార్థక పదం ఏది?
‘విద్యార్థి’ బహువచనం ఏది?
‘పక్షి’ బహువచనం ఏది?
‘చెట్టు’ బహువచనం ఏది?
‘అతడు’ ఏ పురుషానికి చెందుతుంది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: తెలుగు సంప్రదాయ వ్యాకరణంలో ‘అతడు’ ప్రథమ పురుష సర్వనామం.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ‘నేను’ ఏ పురుషానికి చెందుతుంది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: ‘నేను’ మాట్లాడే వ్యక్తిని సూచిస్తుంది; ఇది ఉత్తమ పురుషం.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ‘నీవు’ ఏ పురుషానికి చెందుతుంది?
‘అతను వస్తున్నాడు’ ఏ కాలాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది?
‘ఆమె వచ్చింది’ ఏ కాలం?
‘వారు రేపు వస్తారు’ ఏ కాలాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది?
‘పిల్లి పాలు తాగింది’ వాక్యంలో కర్మ ఏది?
‘రవి బాగా పాడాడు’ వాక్యంలో క్రియావిశేషణం ఏది?
‘నీలి ఆకాశం’లో విశేషణం ఏది?
‘మరియు’ అనే పదం సాధారణంగా ఏ పని చేస్తుంది?
‘కానీ’ అనే పదం ఏ భావాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది?
‘ఎందుకంటే’ అనే పదం ఏ సంబంధాన్ని చూపుతుంది?
‘ఇక్కడ’ అనే పదం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
‘నిన్న’ అనే పదం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
‘రేపు’ అనే పదం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
‘ఉదయం’కు వ్యతిరేక కాల సూచనగా ఏది సరిపోతుంది?
‘స్నేహితుడు’కు సమానార్థక పదం ఏది?
‘శత్రువు’కు వ్యతిరేక భావం కలిగిన పదం ఏది?
‘ఆహారం’కు సమానార్థక పదం ఏది?
‘వైద్యుడు’ ఏ వృత్తికి చెందినవాడు?
‘రైతు’ ప్రధానంగా ఏ పని చేస్తాడు?
‘కవి’ ఏమి రచిస్తాడు?
‘కథ’లో పాత్రలు అంటే ఏమిటి?
కథలో ‘ప్రధాన భావం’ అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: ప్రధాన భావం కథ యొక్క కేంద్ర ఆలోచన.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: కవితలో ‘ఛందస్సు’ ప్రధానంగా దేనికి సంబంధించినది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: ఛందస్సు కవితలో లయ, అక్షర గణన వంటి అంశాలకు సంబంధించినది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ‘ఉపమ’ అలంకారంలో సాధారణంగా ఏమి ఉంటుంది?
‘రూపకం’ అలంకారం ఏమి చేస్తుంది?
options: ఒక విషయాన్ని మరొక విషయంగా నేరుగా చూపిస్తుంది

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: సామెత అంటే ఏమిటి?
జీవిత చరిత్ర అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: జీవిత చరిత్రలో వ్యక్తి జీవితం గురించి వివరిస్తారు.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ఆత్మకథ అంటే ఏమిటి?
నాటకంలో సంభాషణ అంటే ఏమిటి?
కథలో నేపథ్యం అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: నేపథ్యం కథ యొక్క కాలం, స్థలాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: కథా వస్తువు అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: కథా వస్తువు కథలోని సంఘటనల క్రమాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: కథలో సంఘర్షణ అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: సంఘర్షణ కథను ముందుకు నడిపే సమస్య లేదా పోరాటం.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: కథ ముగింపులో పరిష్కారం అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: పరిష్కారం కథలోని ప్రధాన సమస్య ఎలా ముగిసిందో తెలియజేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: పేరాగ్రాఫ్‌లో ప్రధానంగా ఏమి ఉండాలి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: మంచి పేరాగ్రాఫ్ ఒక ప్రధాన భావాన్ని అభివృద్ధి చేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: వ్యాసం రాయడానికి ముందు ఏది ఉపయోగకరం?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: ముందుగా ప్రణాళిక చేసుకోవడం వ్యాసాన్ని క్రమబద్ధం చేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: వ్యాస ముగింపు భాగంలో ఏమి చేయాలి?
ఔపచారిక లేఖలో ఏది అవసరం?
సారాంశం అంటే ఏమిటి?
ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్‌లో ఏమి పరిశీలిస్తారు?
పూర్ణవిరామం సాధారణంగా ఎక్కడ వాడతారు?
అల్పవిరామం (,) ఏ పనికి ఉపయోగపడుతుంది?
options: వాక్యంలో చిన్న విరామం లేదా అంశాల విభజన
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: అల్పవిరామం వాక్యంలో విరామాన్ని లేదా జాబితా అంశాలను సూచిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: విస్మయార్థక చిహ్నం (!) ఎప్పుడు వాడతారు?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: విస్మయార్థకం ఆశ్చర్యం లేదా బలమైన భావాన్ని చూపుతుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: సమానార్థక పదాలు అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: ఒకే లేదా దగ్గర అర్థం కలిగిన పదాలు
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: సమానార్థక పదాలకు ఒకే లేదా దగ్గర అర్థం ఉంటుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: వ్యతిరేక పదాలు అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: వ్యతిరేక పదాలు పరస్పరం భిన్నమైన అర్థాలను కలిగి ఉంటాయి.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: నామవాచకం అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: వ్యక్తి, వస్తువు, స్థలం లేదా భావం పేరు

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: సర్వనామం అంటే ఏమిటి?
క్రియ అంటే ఏమిటి?
విశేషణం అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: నామవాచకానికి గుణం లేదా లక్షణం తెలిపే పదం

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: క్రియావిశేషణం అంటే ఏమిటి?
వాక్య కర్త అంటే ఎవరు లేదా ఏమిటి?
options: వాక్యంలో చర్య చేసే లేదా ప్రధానంగా చెప్పబడే అంశం
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: కర్త వాక్యంలో ప్రధానంగా చెప్పబడే లేదా చర్య చేసే అంశం.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: వాక్యంలో కర్మ అంటే ఏమిటి?
భూతకాలం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
వర్తమాన కాలం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: వర్తమాన కాలం ప్రస్తుత చర్య లేదా స్థితిని సూచిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: భవిష్యత్ కాలం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
పఠన అవగాహన అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: పఠన అవగాహన చదివిన విషయపు అర్థాన్ని గ్రహించడం.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: పాఠ్యంలో ప్రధాన భావాన్ని గుర్తించడం ఏ నైపుణ్యం?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: ప్రధాన భావాన్ని గుర్తించడం పఠన అవగాహనలో భాగం.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: పాఠ్యంలో ఆధారాల ఆధారంగా అర్థం ఊహించడం ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: పాఠ్య ఆధారాలు, పూర్వజ్ఞానం ఉపయోగించి నిర్ధారణకు రావచ్చు.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: వాస్తవం మరియు అభిప్రాయం మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
options: వాస్తవాన్ని ఆధారాలతో తనిఖీ చేయవచ్చు; అభిప్రాయం వ్యక్తిగత అభిప్రాయం
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: వాస్తవాన్ని ధృవీకరించవచ్చు; అభిప్రాయం వ్యక్తిగత దృక్కోణాన్ని తెలియజేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: వక్తను శ్రద్ధగా వినడం ఏ నైపుణ్యానికి చెందుతుంది?
సమూహ చర్చలో మంచి పద్ధతి ఏది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: మంచి చర్చలో వినడం, గౌరవంగా స్పందించడం అవసరం.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ఒక ప్రసంగంలో ఏది ముఖ్యమైనది?
పదకోశం ఉపయోగించడం వల్ల ఏమి తెలుసుకోవచ్చు?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: పదకోశం పదాల అర్థాలు, ఉచ్చారణ సమాచారాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: కొత్త పదాన్ని గుర్తుంచుకోవడానికి మంచి మార్గం ఏది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: కొత్త పదాన్ని వాక్యంలో వాడటం దాని అర్థాన్ని గుర్తుంచుకోవడంలో సహాయపడుతుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: వ్యాసంలో అనుసంధాన పదాలు ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: అనుసంధాన పదాలు భావాల మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని స్పష్టం చేస్తాయి.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: సుసంబద్ధమైన పేరాగ్రాఫ్ అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: సుసంబద్ధత అంటే ఆలోచనలు తార్కికంగా అనుసంధానమై ఉండటం.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: సూచన లేదా మూలాన్ని పేర్కొనడం ఎందుకు అవసరం?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: మూలాన్ని పేర్కొనడం ద్వారా రచనకు ఆధారం, గుర్తింపు లభిస్తాయి.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ప్లేజరిజం అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: ఇతరుల రచనను సరైన గుర్తింపు లేకుండా తమదిగా చూపడం

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: సవరణ (revision) మరియు ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్ మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
options: సవరణలో భావం/నిర్మాణం మెరుగుపరుస్తారు; ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్‌లో చిన్న తప్పులు చూస్తారు
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: సవరణ భావం, నిర్మాణాన్ని మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది; ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్ ఉపరితల తప్పులను గుర్తిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: పరీక్షలో బహుళైచ్ఛిక ప్రశ్నకు మంచి లక్షణం ఏది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: మంచి MCQ స్పష్టంగా ఉండి ఒక నిర్దిష్ట సరైన సమాధానాన్ని కలిగి ఉంటుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: ప్రశ్నకు వివరణ ఇవ్వడం వల్ల ఏమి లాభం?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: వివరణ విద్యార్థికి సరైన సమాధానం వెనుక కారణాన్ని అర్థం చేసుకోవడంలో సహాయపడుతుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాష్ట్ర రాజధాని ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: తెలుగు భాష ఏ లిపిలో ప్రధానంగా వ్రాయబడుతుంది?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: తెలుగు భాషకు ప్రత్యేకమైన తెలుగు లిపి ఉంది.

Class 12 - Telugu AP.q: సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: తెలుగు అచ్చులు సాధారణంగా ఎన్ని?
Class 12 - Telugu AP.why: సాంప్రదాయ తెలుగు వర్ణమాలలో సాధారణంగా 16 అచ్చులు బోధిస్తారు; పాఠ్యపుస్తక విధానాన్ని బట్టి వివరాలు మారవచ్చు.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: కవితలో ‘ఛందస్సు’ దేనికి సంబంధించినది?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: ఛందస్సు కవితలో లయ, అక్షర గణనకు సంబంధించినది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: ‘ఉపమ’ అలంకారంలో ఏమి ఉంటుంది?
‘రూపకం’ అలంకారం ఏమి చేస్తుంది?
options: ఒక విషయాన్ని మరొక విషయంగా నేరుగా చూపిస్తుంది

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సామెత అంటే ఏమిటి?
జీవిత చరిత్ర అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: జీవిత చరిత్రలో వ్యక్తి జీవితం గురించి వివరిస్తారు.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: ఆత్మకథ అంటే ఏమిటి?
నాటకంలో సంభాషణ అంటే ఏమిటి?
కథలో నేపథ్యం అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: నేపథ్యం కథ యొక్క కాలం, స్థలాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: కథా వస్తువు అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: కథా వస్తువు కథలోని సంఘటనల క్రమాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: కథలో సంఘర్షణ అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: సంఘర్షణ కథను ముందుకు నడిపే సమస్య లేదా పోరాటం.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: కథ ముగింపులో పరిష్కారం అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: పరిష్కారం కథలోని ప్రధాన సమస్య ఎలా ముగిసిందో తెలియజేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: పేరాగ్రాఫ్‌లో ప్రధానంగా ఏమి ఉండాలి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: మంచి పేరాగ్రాఫ్ ఒక ప్రధాన భావాన్ని అభివృద్ధి చేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: వ్యాసం రాయడానికి ముందు ఏది ఉపయోగకరం?
వ్యాస ముగింపు భాగంలో ఏమి చేయాలి?
ఔపచారిక లేఖలో ఏది అవసరం?
సారాంశం అంటే ఏమిటి?
ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్‌లో ఏమి పరిశీలిస్తారు?
పూర్ణవిరామం సాధారణంగా ఎక్కడ వాడతారు?
అల్పవిరామం (,) ఏ పనికి ఉపయోగపడుతుంది?
options: వాక్యంలో చిన్న విరామం లేదా అంశాల విభజన
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: అల్పవిరామం వాక్యంలో విరామాన్ని లేదా జాబితా అంశాలను సూచిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: విస్మయార్థక చిహ్నం (!) ఎప్పుడు వాడతారు?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: విస్మయార్థకం ఆశ్చర్యం లేదా బలమైన భావాన్ని చూపుతుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సమానార్థక పదాలు అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: ఒకే లేదా దగ్గర అర్థం కలిగిన పదాలు
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: సమానార్థక పదాలకు ఒకే లేదా దగ్గర అర్థం ఉంటుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: వ్యతిరేక పదాలు అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: వ్యతిరేక పదాలు పరస్పరం భిన్నమైన అర్థాలను కలిగి ఉంటాయి.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: నామవాచకం అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: వ్యక్తి, వస్తువు, స్థలం లేదా భావం పేరు

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సర్వనామం అంటే ఏమిటి?
క్రియ అంటే ఏమిటి?
విశేషణం అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: నామవాచకానికి గుణం లేదా లక్షణం తెలిపే పదం

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: క్రియావిశేషణం అంటే ఏమిటి?
వాక్య కర్త అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: వాక్యంలో చర్య చేసే లేదా ప్రధానంగా చెప్పబడే అంశం

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: వాక్యంలో కర్మ అంటే ఏమిటి?
భూతకాలం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
వర్తమాన కాలం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: వర్తమాన కాలం ప్రస్తుత చర్య లేదా స్థితిని సూచిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: భవిష్యత్ కాలం ఏది సూచిస్తుంది?
పఠన అవగాహన అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: పఠన అవగాహన చదివిన విషయపు అర్థాన్ని గ్రహించడం.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: పాఠ్యంలో ప్రధాన భావాన్ని గుర్తించడం ఏ నైపుణ్యం?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: ప్రధాన భావాన్ని గుర్తించడం పఠన అవగాహనలో భాగం.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: పాఠ్యంలో ఆధారాల ఆధారంగా అర్థం ఊహించడం ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: పాఠ్య ఆధారాలు, పూర్వజ్ఞానం ఉపయోగించి నిర్ధారణకు రావచ్చు.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: వాస్తవం మరియు అభిప్రాయం మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
options: వాస్తవాన్ని ఆధారాలతో తనిఖీ చేయవచ్చు; అభిప్రాయం వ్యక్తిగత అభిప్రాయం
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: వాస్తవాన్ని ధృవీకరించవచ్చు; అభిప్రాయం వ్యక్తిగత దృక్కోణాన్ని తెలియజేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: వక్తను శ్రద్ధగా వినడం ఏ నైపుణ్యం?
సమూహ చర్చలో మంచి పద్ధతి ఏది?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: మంచి చర్చలో వినడం, గౌరవంగా స్పందించడం అవసరం.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: ప్రసంగంలో ఏది ముఖ్యమైనది?
పదకోశం ఉపయోగించడం వల్ల ఏమి తెలుసుకోవచ్చు?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: పదకోశం పదాల అర్థాలు, ఉచ్చారణ సమాచారాన్ని అందిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: కొత్త పదాన్ని గుర్తుంచుకోవడానికి మంచి మార్గం ఏది?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: కొత్త పదాన్ని వాక్యంలో వాడటం అర్థాన్ని గుర్తుంచుకోవడంలో సహాయపడుతుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: వ్యాసంలో అనుసంధాన పదాలు ఎందుకు ఉపయోగిస్తారు?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: అనుసంధాన పదాలు భావాల మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని స్పష్టం చేస్తాయి.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సుసంబద్ధమైన పేరాగ్రాఫ్ అంటే ఏమిటి?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: సుసంబద్ధత అంటే ఆలోచనలు తార్కికంగా అనుసంధానమై ఉండటం.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: మూలాన్ని పేర్కొనడం ఎందుకు అవసరం?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: మూలాన్ని పేర్కొనడం ద్వారా రచనకు ఆధారం లభిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: ప్లేజరిజం అంటే ఏమిటి?
options: ఇతరుల రచనను సరైన గుర్తింపు లేకుండా తమదిగా చూపడం

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సవరణ మరియు ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్ మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
options: సవరణలో భావం/నిర్మాణం మెరుగుపరుస్తారు; ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్‌లో చిన్న తప్పులు చూస్తారు
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: సవరణ భావం, నిర్మాణాన్ని మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది; ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్ చిన్న తప్పులను గుర్తిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: బహుళైచ్ఛిక ప్రశ్నకు మంచి లక్షణం ఏది?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: మంచి MCQ స్పష్టంగా ఉండి ఒక నిర్దిష్ట సరైన సమాధానాన్ని కలిగి ఉంటుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: ప్రశ్నకు వివరణ ఇవ్వడం వల్ల ఏమి లాభం?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: వివరణ సరైన సమాధానం వెనుక కారణాన్ని అర్థం చేసుకోవడంలో సహాయపడుతుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర రాజధాని ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్రం ఏ సంవత్సరంలో ఏర్పడింది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: తెలంగాణలో ప్రధానంగా మాట్లాడే భాష ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: తెలుగు భాష ఏ లిపిలో వ్రాయబడుతుంది?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: తెలుగు భాషకు ప్రత్యేకమైన తెలుగు లిపి ఉంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘అమ్మ’ అనే పదానికి అర్థం ఏమిటి?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘నాన్న’ అనే పదానికి అర్థం ఏమిటి?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘నీరు’కు సమానార్థక పదం ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘ఆకాశం’కు సమానార్థక పదం ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘సంతోషం’కు వ్యతిరేక పదం ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘పెద్ద’కు వ్యతిరేక పదం ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘వేగంగా’కు దగ్గర అర్థం ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘పుస్తకం’ బహువచనం ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘బాలుడు’ స్త్రీలింగ రూపం ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘నేను పాఠశాలకు వెళ్తాను’ వాక్యంలో కర్త ఎవరు?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘రాముడు పుస్తకం చదివాడు’ వాక్యంలో క్రియ ఏది?
సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ప్రశ్నార్థక వాక్యం చివర ఏ చిహ్నం వాడతారు?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: ప్రశ్నార్థక వాక్యం చివర ప్రశ్నార్థక చిహ్నం వాడతారు.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘అయ్యో!’ ఏ భావాన్ని తెలియజేస్తుంది?
Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: సందర్భాన్ని బట్టి బాధ లేదా ఆశ్చర్యాన్ని తెలియజేస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.q: సరైన సమాధానాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి: ‘మంచి’కు వ్యతిరేక పదం ఏది?

Class 12 - Telugu Telangana.why: సవరణ భావం, నిర్మాణాన్ని మెరుగుపరుస్తుంది; ప్రూఫ్‌రీడింగ్ చిన్న తప్పులను గుర్తిస్తుంది.

Class 12 - Tibetan.q: Which region is most closely associated with the Tibetan language?

Class 12 - Tibetan.q: Which writing system is used for classical Tibetan?
Class 12 - Tibetan.why: Correct answer: Tibetan script.

Class 12 - Tibetan.q: Classical Tibetan writing is historically related to which broad script tradition?
Class 12 - Tibetan.why: Correct answer: An Indic-derived script tradition.

Class 12 - Tibetan.q: Which direction is Tibetan script normally written?
